$comment: Security headers for the deployed static app (web/ is the Vercel project root). The CSP mirrors the meta tag injected at build time, plus frame-ancestors (which a meta tag cannot set). connect-src is the exfiltration lock. IMPORTANT: this header is static and cannot read env, but production enforces BOTH this header AND the env-driven meta tag, so if you enable online sharing you MUST widen connect-src here too. The Supabase wildcard covers any project; REPLACE the https://YOUR-CLOUD-DOMAIN placeholder with your upload Worker's origin (same as VITE_CLOUD_API), or remove both extra origins to keep the app fully local.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' 'unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' blob:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://*.supabase.co wss://*.supabase.co https://YOUR-CLOUD-DOMAIN; worker-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'; frame-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
